name: Rune Adu
location: Hamtramck Enclave, operates out of a converted ground-floor unit called Leclair's Clean & Press, near Kedzie and Division
description:
Abiodun is a broad-shouldered man whose body has softened into comfortable middle age, his dark brown skin lined around the eyes and mouth in ways that make him look like he is perpetually on the verge of a knowing smile. His hair is cropped close and silver at the temples; he wears it simply, without augmentation, which marks him as either principled or broke depending on who is asking. His hands are always slightly chapped from the solvents, and he keeps a small tin of shea balm in his breast pocket that he reapplies with absent-minded regularity. He has one augmentation: a subdermal pressure sensor array in his fingertips that helps him feel thread tension and fabric stress without instruments — technically a legacy medical implant from a reconstructive surgery after a crush injury thirty years ago, repurposed into professional utility.

Abi runs Leclair's Clean & Press the way a priest runs a parish — with patience, with routine, and with the faint conviction that cleanliness is a moral act. He is warm with regulars, methodical with strangers, and briefly terrible with anyone who brings him synthweave and claims it is linen. He remembers what every customer wore to their daughter's naming ceremony, their court date, their first corporate interview. He has seen the whole neighborhood change twice over and has quietly outlasted two corponation rezoning attempts by simply continuing to open at six in the morning.

core_fears: Being evicted from the shop his late wife helped him open
Becoming invisible — dismissed as just the laundry man
core_desires: To be recognized as someone who kept the neighborhood together
To eventually teach the trade to someone who actually wants to learn it
coping_mechanisms: Maintaining rigid daily routine as emotional scaffolding
Talking to the E.L.F. he believes inhabits his oldest pressing machine
blind_spots: Underestimates how much people take advantage of his patience
Cannot see that his refusal to raise prices is slowly bankrupting him
psychology.secret: He has been quietly laundering — in the financial sense — small sums for a local mutual aid network that operates outside corporate tax jurisdiction. He tells himself it is the same as hiding food during a famine. He is terrified this is a lie he tells himself.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Formal Yoruba-inflected French structure mapped onto English, precise and slightly archaic; uses trade terminology as metaphor
speech_patterns.cadence: Deliberate, unhurried, with long pauses before important points as if pressing the words flat
verbal_tics: Clicks tongue when frustrated rather than speaking
Calls everyone 'friend' the first time he meets them
example_lines: 'Bring it back Thursday. I do not rush a good press — you rush it and you get lines where there should be none, you understand me?'
'This fabric has memory. Everything does. You treat it badly, it will hold the shape of that for years.'

story_hooks: A jacket left unclaimed for six months contains a data chip sewn into the lining; the owner has not come back because they cannot
The corponation rezoning notice has finally come — Abi has thirty days and a block council that is fracturing over whether to fight or take the buyout
The E.L.F. in his pressing machine has started giving him numbers — lottery-style sequences — and two of them have already corresponded to events that came true
narrative_function: Neighborhood anchor and information node — he knows everyone's laundry schedule and therefore their lives; quest giver for neighborhood-level problems, provider of local gossip, safe harbor character who can hide things in plain sight among clean linens
augmentations: Legacy subdermal pressure sensor array in both hands (medical origin, repurposed for trade); no cosmetic mods
daily_life: Opens the shop at 0600, runs three load cycles before most neighbors are awake, does alterations in the afternoon when the machines are cooling, closes by 2100 and eats dinner alone watching archive footage of Beninese football matches.
affiliation: Independent; informal ties to the Hamtramck Enclave block council

decision_rules: Never refuse a customer who genuinely cannot pay this week — log it as credit
Do not discuss other customers' business, ever, under any pressure
If something feels wrong about a drop-off, hold it for seventy-two hours before touching it
escalation_ladder: Withdrawal of warmth and complete professional coldness
Asking them to leave and not return

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Courteous and slightly formal, assesses them by what they bring in and how they ask
interpersonal_modes.friends: Teasing, generous, remembers every detail of their lives and references them unexpectedly

stress_responses.low: Finds extra work to do with his hands
stress_responses.medium: Goes very quiet and very methodical — all emotional energy channels into the machines
stress_responses.high: Sits in the back and talks to the E.L.F. in the pressing machine for long stretches

contradictions: Believes deeply in community and collective survival but is fundamentally private and will not ask for help himself
habits: Reapplies shea balm to his hands every two hours
Hums Beninese folk songs while sorting — different songs for different fabric types
Leaves a small data-token offering on top of the pressing machine each morning
breaking_points: Someone threatening a vulnerable regular in his shop
Being told the mutual aid network has been exposed

timeline.event: Born in the Hamtramck Enclave to a Beninese-Polish immigrant family
Crush injury at a loading dock; receives subdermal sensor implants during reconstruction
Opens Leclair's Clean & Press with his wife Ivette
Ivette dies of a cardiac event; Abi continues the shop
First corponation rezoning attempt; block council successfully contests it

physical_description.heritage: Complex diaspora blend: East Asian (33.6%) forms the primary phenotypic foundation with slight eye shape and cheekbone structure; Central Asian (18.5%) contributes to facial width and bone structure; Sub-Saharan African (16.0%) adds warmth to skin tone and facial feature definition; Hispanic/Latin American (15.0%) and Northern European (13.5%) provide secondary influences on complexion and lighter undertones; North African (3.4%) subtle influence on skin undertone warmth.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and thick through the chest, softened into comfortable middle age with a slight belly that speaks of routine and stability rather than neglect. Still carries the framework of a laborer beneath the wear.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with silver at the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Cropped close, no fade or design; utilitarian and unadorned
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with subtle epicanthic fold
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium warm brown with golden undertones, blended from East Asian and Sub-Saharan ancestry with slight warmth from Hispanic and North African heritage
physical_description.complexion: Face lined at the eyes and mouth in ways that suggest a permanent near-smile; weathered but well-maintained. Laugh lines prominent. Subtle East Asian cheekbone structure softened by age and robust build. Hands perpetually slightly chapped from solvent exposure; kept scrupulously clean with visible calluses on fingertips and palms.
distinguishing_marks: Fine network of scars across both palms and inner wrists — pale and faded, running in parallel lines from old crush injury and subsequent reconstructive surgery thirty years prior
Slight discoloration on right index and middle fingers from decades of solvent contact, darkened at the cuticles
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. The subdermal pressure sensor array in fingertips is not apparent to casual observation — only noticeable through his deliberate, precise hand movements and the way he touches fabrics without instruments.
physical_description.posture_movement: Carries himself with the quiet confidence of someone who has owned his space for decades. Moves with deliberate economy — no wasted motion. Hands are frequently in motion: adjusting fabric, checking seams, unconsciously applying shea balm to fingertips. Stands with weight balanced, ready to move between machines. Body language defaults to attentive and patient, with occasional brief flares of exasperation when discussing synthweave.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working class, practical and durable. Standard uniform is a long grey cotton shop coat (tailored to fit, naturally), worn over simple neutral clothing — usually dark slacks and a short-sleeved button shirt in muted colors (navy, charcoal, warm grey). Work boots with good arch support, scuffed but maintained. Small tin of shea balm visible in breast pocket. No jewelry except a simple brass wedding band on left ring finger. Clothes always immaculate despite the work environment — a point of professional and personal pride.
